lineage.prompt:
Repaint this rough colour-blocking sketch as a finished sheet of eight round portrait avatars for a cheerful children's learning game set under the sea. Keep exactly the same layout: eight round brass porthole frames with rivets, in two rows of four, each in the same place and the same size as in the sketch, on the plain light grey background. In each porthole is a different friendly child diver, about eight years old, shown head and shoulders and facing the viewer with a big, happy smile, a diving mask pushed up on the forehead and a wetsuit collar, against soft turquoise water. Top row, left to right: a girl with fair skin, freckles and orange curly hair in two puffs, a turquoise wetsuit and a yellow mask; a boy with dark brown skin and short black curly hair, an orange wetsuit and a blue mask; a girl with light brown skin and a long black ponytail, a purple wetsuit and a pink mask; a boy with fair skin and messy blond hair, a green wetsuit and an orange mask. Bottom row, left to right: a girl with dark brown skin and black hair in a high bun, a coral-red wetsuit and a turquoise mask; a boy with light olive skin and wavy brown hair, a yellow wetsuit and a red mask; a child with fair skin and a short brown bob, a pink wetsuit and a green mask; a girl with brown skin and long dark braids, a blue wetsuit and a purple mask. Every child has a clearly different face, hair and skin tone and their own gear colours; simple, big, readable features with large eyes, so each portrait still reads when it is small.
Storybook gouache and watercolour painting with soft brush texture and gentle shading, light from the top left; rounded, friendly shapes; bright, harmonious colours. A clean, confident, medium-weight outline in deep plum-brown (not black) around the children and their main shapes. No sticker border and no white edge around the outline.
Keep the plain, flat, evenly lit light grey background around the portholes, with no glow, no light rays, no vignette and no shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.

The grotto has the arch to the sea, shelves with shells and glowing pearls, and an open sand floor for the friends and decorations. Which map should I use, with this grotto?

lineage.prompt:
Repaint this rough colour-blocking sketch as a finished, beautifully painted background for a cheerful children's learning game set under the sea: Slunná laguna, a sunny, shallow tropical lagoon seen from inside the water. Keep exactly the same composition: bright sunbeams slanting down from the shimmering surface; a wide, calm, open band of clear turquoise water and smooth sand running diagonally from the bottom left up to the top right, kept plain and uncluttered because the game draws its level path there; in the top-left corner a rocky ledge with swaying kelp and a purple sea fan; in the bottom-right corner a lush garden of branching pink, orange and purple corals with a yellow sea star; at the right edge a big rounded reef rock with a dark, mysterious hole in it, where a sea monster lives, mysterious but not scary; the soft sandy sea floor along the bottom with a few seashells and pebbles. Tiny bubbles rising, gentle caustic light ripples on the sand.
Style: storybook gouache and watercolour painting, soft brush texture, rounded friendly shapes, bright saturated but harmonious palette of turquoise, aqua blue, coral pink, sunny yellow and sand beige, gentle depth haze toward the back. Calm, magical and inviting.
No fish, no animals, no people, no characters, no monster, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border.
